paper_title: Constraints on axionlike dark matter with masses down to $10^{-23}$ eV/c$^2$
notes: Paper reports constraint as Fa/Ce >= 2e15 eV (Ce/Fa <= 5e-16 eV^-1) over much of mass range 1e-23 to 1e-18 eV. Limit shown graphically in Fig.5 as Ce/Fa vs ma; no numerical table in main text. Converted headline value to approximate g_ae using g_ae ~ 2*m_e*Ce/Fa, but the paper natively constrains Ce/Fa not g_ae, so coupling normalization is uncertain. Data points are flat approximations at the quoted plateau limit; actual limit degrades near sidereal bump (~47 zeV) and at highest masses.
